questions.q_zh: 山顶地图上一块三角形观察区边长为 6、8、10 厘米，放大后最长边为 25 厘米，最短边几厘米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A summit weather model predicts temperature T = 6 - 2h, where h is hours after dawn. What temperature in °C does it predict after 5 hours?
questions.q_zh: 山顶气温模型为 T=6-2h，h 是日出后小时数，5 小时后预测温度几摄氏度？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A hut sells a summit photo for $24 before a 12.5% discount. What is the discounted price in dollars?
questions.q_zh: 小屋一张山顶照片原价 24 元，减价 12.5% 后几元？

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: On Horstman Glacier, more surface ice melts than the glacier gains from snowfall over a year. What is the annual mass balance?
questions.q_zh: 霍斯特曼冰川一年融化损失的冰量超过降雪补给量，该年物质平衡如何？
questions.explain_en: Annual mass balance is gain minus loss; greater loss gives a negative result.
questions.explain_zh: 年物质平衡为补给减去损失，损失较大时为负。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Two summit snow samples have the same mass. One occupies twice the volume of the other. How does its density compare?
questions.q_zh: 两份山顶雪样质量相同，其中一份体积是另一份的两倍，它的密度是另一份的多少？
questions.explain_en: Density is mass divided by volume, so doubling volume at equal mass halves density.
questions.explain_zh: 密度等于质量除以体积，质量相同而体积加倍，密度减半。
